info.name: MentorConnect Edge API - end to end flow
info.description:
# MentorConnect Edge API - end to end flow

Runs the whole Sprint 2 flow: accounts, mentor profile, verification, search, booking, session, notifications and chat. Every request has a test script and the status code is in the request name.

## Asgardeo tokens (login is Asgardeo only)
Before a run, paste one Asgardeo access token per role into the collection variables: `adminToken`, `mentorToken`, `studentToken`, `outsiderToken`.
Get each token with the Asgardeo login collection (Authorization > Get New Access Token), logging in as a different Asgardeo test user each time. The admin user must be the one in `migrations/0002_seed.sql`; the other users must not be registered yet, so reset the local database before each run:
`Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .wrangler\state` then `npx wrangler d1 migrations apply mentorconnect-db --local`.
Tokens expire after about an hour.

## Before you run
1. Reset and migrate the local database (see above).
2. Start the Worker: `npm run dev` (http://127.0.0.1:8787).
3. Paste the four tokens into the collection variables.

## How to run
Run the collection from top to bottom with the Collection Runner (or `newman run <file>`). Do not run single requests out of order: ids are saved into collection variables (mentorUserId, studentId, mentorId, slot1Id, bookingId, ...).

## Notes
- The slot is 3 days ahead, so starting the session (B14) must return 409 `Too early`.
- A reviews request is not included, because a review needs a COMPLETED session and the start window is 15 minutes before the slot.
- Change `baseUrl` to test a deployed Worker.

item.name: A. Setup: accounts, mentor profile, verification, search
A10. Mentor creates slot 1, 3 days ahead (201)
A10b. Mentor gets verification upload url (200)
A10c. Mentor uploads the document to R2 (200)

exec: pm.test("mentor is in the result", () => pm.expect(j.content.some(m => m.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('mentorId'))).to.be.true);

item.name: A14. Student lists the mentor's slots (200)

exec: pm.test("slot 1 is listed", () => pm.expect(j.some(s => s.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('slot1Id') && s.status === 'AVAILABLE')).to.be.true);

pm.test("mentor, slot and student match", () => pm.expect(j.mentorId === pm.collectionVariables.get('mentorId') && j.slotId === pm.collectionVariables.get('slot1Id') && j.studentId === pm.collectionVariables.get('studentId')).to.be.true);

item.name: B2. Duplicate booking for the same slot (409)
B3. Mentor cannot create a booking (403)
B6. Get booking as another user (403)
B13. Get session as student (200 SCHEDULED)

exec: pm.test("meetingUrl is set", () => pm.expect(typeof j.meetingUrl === 'string' && j.meetingUrl.length > 0).to.be.true);

item.name: B14. Mentor starts session, too early (409)
B15. Mentor creates slot 2, 4 days ahead (201)
B17. Slot 2 is HELD while booking 2 is pending (200)

exec: pm.test("reason is saved", () => pm.expect(j.cancellationReason === 'Flow test cancel').to.be.true);

item.name: C1. List notifications without a token (401)
C4. Mentor cannot read the student's notification (404)
C5. Student marks one notification read (200)
C7. Student has no unread notifications (200)
C10. Student starts conversation with mentor (201)

exec: pm.test("no last message yet", () => pm.expect(j.lastMessage === null && j.unreadCount === 0).to.be.true);

item.name: C11. Start the same conversation again (200)

exec: pm.test("content is saved", () => pm.expect(j.content === 'Hello mentor, see you at the session').to.be.true);

pm.test("conversation has 1 unread and a last message", () => pm.expect(j.some(c => c.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('conversationId') && c.unreadCount === 1 && c.lastMessage && c.lastMessage.content === 'Hello mentor, see you at the session')).to.be.true);

item.name: C19. Unread count is 0 after reading (200)

exec: pm.test("key is under the conversation", () => pm.expect(j.key.startsWith('attachments/' + pm.collectionVariables.get('conversationId') + '/')).to.be.true);
